name: CI

on:
  push:
    # Coordination and support refs run the non-publishing matrix; rollback refs do
    # not match and never execute CI or release policy.
    branches:
      - main
      - dev/*.*.*
      - support/*.*
      - ci-testing/*
      - pull-request/[0-9]+

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: ci-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true


jobs:
  # Select the route before expanding its jobs or matrices. The inactive route
  # has one static name, while the selected local workflow keeps its full CI.
  trusted:
    name: Trusted CI
    if: >-
      github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' ||
      startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/dev/') ||
      startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/support/') ||
      startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/ci-testing/')
    permissions:
      contents: read
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ci-trusted.yml

  # No inherited secrets or write permissions cross into candidate execution.
  candidate:
    name: Candidate CI
    if: startsWith(github.ref, 'refs/heads/pull-request/')
    permissions: {}
    uses: ./.github/workflows/ci-candidate.yml

name: Trusted CI

# Only ci.yml selects this route. Local calls use the exact caller commit;
# ordinary copied-ref reporting binds this file to protected main as well.
on:
  workflow_call:

permissions: {}

jobs:
  trusted_policy:
    name: Policy and documentation
    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu4
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      # Resolve the recorded gitlink without consulting submodule configuration,
      # then fetch it only from the canonical public specification repository.
      - name: Resolve exact specification checkout
        id: source_spec
        run: .github/scripts/resolve-source-spec-gitlink.sh . "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"

      - name: Check out exact specification
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 1
          path: source-spec
          persist-credentials: false
          ref: ${{ steps.source_spec.outputs.sha }}
          repository: NVIDIA/yaml-sigil-spec

      - name: Lint Markdown
        # This section would benefit by a change to the action allowlist
        uses: rvben/rumdl@95a982d941d00cf41a0dcef4d0788bd15a29be1b # v0.2.54
        with:
          version: "0.2.75"

      - name: Lint GitHub Actions workflows
        uses: devops-actions/actionlint@ec02b36684b2f574f1d219ad0a43b082e46bf3e4 # v0.1.13 (actionlint v1.7.12)

      - name: Lint shell scripts
        uses: ludeeus/action-shellcheck@00cae500b08a931fb5698e11e79bfbd38e612a38 # 2.0.0
        with:
          check_together: true
          scandir: .github/scripts
          version: v0.11.0

      - name: Test protected reporter and candidate materialization
        run: |
          python3 -m py_compile \
            .github/scripts/bind-candidate-pr.py \
            .github/scripts/report_required_ci.py \
            .github/scripts/test_bind_candidate_pr.py \
            .github/scripts/test_report_required_ci.py
          python3 -m unittest discover \
            -s .github/scripts -p 'test_*.py'
          .github/scripts/test-materialize-candidate.sh
          .github/scripts/test-check-release-pr.sh
          .github/scripts/test-attach-release-source.sh
          .github/scripts/test-bind-release-invocation.sh
          .github/scripts/check-trusted-tool-pins.sh
          .github/scripts/test-trusted-tool-pins.sh

  trusted_stable:
    name: Rust 1.98.0 (Linux)
    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu8
    timeout-minutes: 60
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      RUSTFLAGS: -D warnings
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Rust 1.98.0
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@166cdcfd11aee3cb47222f9ddb555ce30ddb9659 # v1.17.0
        with:
          cache: false
          components: clippy, rustfmt
          toolchain: 1.98.0

      - name: Install Rust validation tools
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@9114bf4d891761788c546334fd37538eae1bf8b3 # v2.87.16
        with:
          checksum: true
          fallback: none
          tool: cargo-audit@0.22.2,cargo-deny@0.20.2,cargo-machete@0.9.2

      - name: Verify exact dependency-policy tools
        run: |
          test "$(cargo-audit --version)" = "cargo-audit 0.22.2"
          test "$(cargo-deny --version)" = "cargo-deny 0.20.2"

      - name: Restore trusted Rust build cache
        uses: Swatinem/rust-cache@6323deb102c322ba6fcbdcafc7e3dddab59af2b6 # v2.9.2
        with:
          cache-bin: false
          cache-targets: false
          save-if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}

      # Markdown and provider-specific policy checks run in trusted_policy.
      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt --all --check

      - name: Check xtask formatting
        run: cargo fmt --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml --all --check

      # Validate release-manifest policy and compare the source inventory.
      # Markdown runs in trusted_policy; formatting, compilation, Clippy,
      # tests, and dependency checks run as separate steps.
      - name: Check release manifest and package contents
        run: cargo xtask check --only=package-content

      - name: Check crate compilation
        run: cargo check --all-targets --all-features

      - name: Check xtask compilation
        run: >-
          cargo check --locked --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml
          --all-targets --all-features

      - name: Lint crate
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Lint xtask
        run: >-
          cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml
          --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Test crate
        run: cargo test --all-features

      - name: Test xtask
        run: cargo test --locked --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml --all-features

      - name: Check unused dependencies
        run: cargo-machete --with-metadata

      - name: Check crate dependency policy
        run: cargo-deny --all-features check bans licenses sources -D warnings

      - name: Check xtask dependency policy
        run: >-
          cargo-deny --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml --locked --all-features
          check bans licenses sources -D warnings

      - name: Audit crate dependencies
        run: cargo audit

      - name: Audit xtask dependencies
        run: cargo audit --file xtask/Cargo.lock

  trusted_msrv:
    name: Rust 1.95.0 (Linux)
    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu8
    timeout-minutes: 40
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      RUSTFLAGS: -D warnings
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Set up Rust 1.95.0
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@166cdcfd11aee3cb47222f9ddb555ce30ddb9659 # v1.17.0
        with:
          cache: false
          toolchain: 1.95.0

      - name: Test crate at the declared Rust version
        run: cargo +1.95.0 test --all-features

      - name: Test xtask at the declared Rust version
        run: cargo +1.95.0 test --locked --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml

  trusted_linux:
    name: Linux result
    if: ${{ always() }}
    needs:
      - trusted_policy
      - trusted_stable
      - trusted_msrv
    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu4
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions: {}
    steps:
      - name: Require every authoritative Linux lane
        env:
          MSRV_RESULT: ${{ needs.trusted_msrv.result }}
          POLICY_RESULT: ${{ needs.trusted_policy.result }}
          STABLE_RESULT: ${{ needs.trusted_stable.result }}
        run: |
          test "${POLICY_RESULT}" = success
          test "${STABLE_RESULT}" = success
          test "${MSRV_RESULT}" = success

  trusted_portability:
    name: Portability (${{ matrix.name }})
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    continue-on-error: true
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions:
      contents: read
    env:
      RUSTFLAGS: -D warnings
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: macOS
            runner: macos-latest
          - name: Windows
            runner: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Check out repository
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          persist-credentials: false

      - name: Remove unused preinstalled Homebrew source
        if: ${{ runner.os == 'macOS' }}
        run: .github/scripts/remove-preinstalled-aws-tap.sh

      - name: Set up Rust 1.98.0
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@166cdcfd11aee3cb47222f9ddb555ce30ddb9659 # v1.17.0
        with:
          cache: false
          components: clippy, rustfmt
          toolchain: 1.98.0

      - name: Check formatting
        run: cargo fmt --all --check

      - name: Check xtask formatting
        run: cargo fmt --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml --all --check

      # Only validate release-manifest policy and source inventory here.
      # Formatting and Rust checks run separately; Linux owns Markdown,
      # dependency checks, and provider policy.
      - name: Check release manifest and package contents
        run: cargo xtask check --only=package-content

      - name: Check crate compilation
        run: cargo check --all-targets --all-features

      - name: Check xtask compilation
        run: >-
          cargo check --locked --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml
          --all-targets --all-features

      - name: Lint crate
        run: cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Lint xtask
        run: >-
          cargo clippy --locked --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml
          --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings

      - name: Test crate
        run: cargo test --all-features

      - name: Test xtask
        run: cargo test --locked --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml --all-features

name: Candidate CI

# Only ci.yml selects this route. Local calls use the exact caller commit;
# ordinary copied-ref reporting binds this file to protected main as well.
on:
  workflow_call:

permissions: {}

jobs:
  candidate_binding:
    name: Bind candidate to protected policy and base
    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu4
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions: {}
    outputs:
      base_ref: ${{ steps.pull.outputs.base_ref }}
      base_sha: ${{ steps.pull.outputs.base_sha }}
      policy_sha: ${{ steps.policy.outputs.policy_sha }}
    env:
      GH_TOKEN: ""
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ""
      GIT_ASKPASS: /bin/false
      GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: /dev/null
      GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1"
      GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM: /dev/null
      GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0"
      PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE: "1"
    steps:
      # Bind the run before any candidate-executable job starts. Downstream
      # jobs rebind these exact objects before materializing contributor code.
      - name: Initialize fresh binding state
        run: install -d -m 0700 "${RUNNER_TEMP}/candidate-binding"

      - name: Stage binder from protected current main
        id: policy
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git init --quiet --initial-branch=main .
          git remote add origin \
            "${GITHUB_SERVER_URL}/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git"
          git -c credential.helper= -c http.extraHeader= \
            fetch --quiet --no-tags --no-recurse-submodules --depth=1 \
            origin "+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main"
          policy_sha="$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main)"
          git show \
            "${policy_sha}:.github/scripts/bind-candidate-pr.py" \
            > bind-candidate-pr.py
          chmod 0500 bind-candidate-pr.py
          python3 -m py_compile bind-candidate-pr.py
          printf 'policy_sha=%s\n' "${policy_sha}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/candidate-binding

      - name: Bind copied ref to exact policy and contribution base
        id: pull
        env:
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ steps.policy.outputs.policy_sha }}
        run: >-
          python3 ./bind-candidate-pr.py
          --repository "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"
          --copied-ref "${GITHUB_REF_NAME}"
          --head-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}"
          --policy-sha "${POLICY_SHA}"
          --output "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/candidate-binding

  candidate_linux_lanes:
    name: Candidate ${{ matrix.name }} (Linux)
    needs:
      - candidate_binding
    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu8
    timeout-minutes: 75
    permissions: {}
    env:
      ACTIONS_CACHE_URL: ""
      ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN: ""
      ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL: ""
      ACTIONS_RESULTS_URL: ""
      ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN: ""
      CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ""
      CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_TOKEN: ""
      GH_TOKEN: ""
      GIT_ASKPASS: /bin/false
      GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: /dev/null
      GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1"
      GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM: /dev/null
      GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE: "1"
      GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0"
      GIT_TOKEN: ""
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ""
      PYTHONNOUSERSITE: "1"
      PYTHONSAFEPATH: "1"
      RUSTFLAGS: -D warnings
      RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER: ""
      RUSTC_WRAPPER: ""
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: Rust 1.98.0
            toolchain: 1.98.0
            full: true
          - name: Rust 1.95.0
            toolchain: 1.95.0
            full: false
    steps:
      - name: Create fresh candidate state
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          state="${RUNNER_TEMP}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state"
          test ! -e "${state}"
          install -d -m 0700 \
            "${state}" \
            "${state}/bootstrap" \
            "${state}/cargo-home" \
            "${state}/policy-bin" \
            "${state}/source" \
            "${state}/target" \
            "${state}/tmp"
          printf '%s\n' \
            "CANDIDATE_STATE=${state}" \
            "CARGO_HOME=${state}/cargo-home" \
            "CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${state}/target" \
            "POLICY_BIN=${state}/policy-bin" \
            "TEMP=${state}/tmp" \
            "TMP=${state}/tmp" \
            "TMPDIR=${state}/tmp" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}

      # Complete trusted host setup before any candidate-controlled path exists.
      - name: Set up Rust
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@166cdcfd11aee3cb47222f9ddb555ce30ddb9659 # v1.17.0
        with:
          cache: false
          components: clippy, rustfmt
          toolchain: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}

      - name: Install Rust validation tools
        if: ${{ matrix.full }}
        uses: taiki-e/install-action@9114bf4d891761788c546334fd37538eae1bf8b3 # v2.87.16
        with:
          checksum: true
          fallback: none
          tool: cargo-audit@0.22.2,cargo-deny@0.20.2,cargo-machete@0.9.2,shellcheck@0.11.0

      - name: Install Markdown linter
        if: ${{ matrix.full }}
        # This section would benefit by a change to the action allowlist
        uses: rvben/rumdl@95a982d941d00cf41a0dcef4d0788bd15a29be1b # v0.2.54
        with:
          install-only: true
          version: "0.2.75"

      # Fetch protected main before candidate source exists and stage every
      # policy executable that must survive materialization.
      - name: Stage protected candidate policy
        id: protected_policy
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git -c core.autocrlf=false init --quiet --initial-branch=main .
          git remote add origin "https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git"
          git -c credential.helper= fetch --no-tags --no-recurse-submodules \
            --depth=1 origin \
            "+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main"
          git show \
            refs/remotes/origin/main:.github/scripts/materialize-candidate.sh \
            > "${POLICY_BIN}/materialize-candidate.sh"
          git show \
            refs/remotes/origin/main:.github/scripts/bind-candidate-pr.py \
            > "${POLICY_BIN}/bind-candidate-pr.py"
          git show \
            refs/remotes/origin/main:.github/scripts/check-pull-request-commits.sh \
            > "${POLICY_BIN}/check-pull-request-commits.sh"
          git show \
            refs/remotes/origin/main:.github/scripts/check-release-pr.sh \
            > "${POLICY_BIN}/check-release-pr.sh"
          chmod 0500 \
            "${POLICY_BIN}/bind-candidate-pr.py" \
            "${POLICY_BIN}/check-release-pr.sh" \
            "${POLICY_BIN}/materialize-candidate.sh" \
            "${POLICY_BIN}/check-pull-request-commits.sh"
          printf 'policy_sha=%s\n' \
            "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main)" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/bootstrap

      # Anonymous protected-main policy identifies a canonical repository-owned
      # release branch; ordinary contributor branches produce an empty value.
      - name: Bind current pull request metadata
        id: candidate_pr
        env:
          CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ steps.protected_policy.outputs.policy_sha }}
        shell: bash
        run: >-
          python3 "${POLICY_BIN}/bind-candidate-pr.py"
          --repository "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"
          --copied-ref "${CANDIDATE_REF}"
          --head-sha "${CANDIDATE_SHA}"
          --policy-sha "${POLICY_SHA}"
          --output "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/bootstrap

      # The aggregate verdict records the binding established before any
      # candidate job began. Fail if protected policy or the base moved.
      - name: Match pre-execution policy and base binding
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ steps.candidate_pr.outputs.base_ref }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.candidate_pr.outputs.base_sha }}
          EXPECTED_BASE_REF: ${{ needs.candidate_binding.outputs.base_ref }}
          EXPECTED_BASE_SHA: ${{ needs.candidate_binding.outputs.base_sha }}
          EXPECTED_POLICY_SHA: ${{ needs.candidate_binding.outputs.policy_sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ steps.protected_policy.outputs.policy_sha }}
        run: |
          test "${POLICY_SHA}" = "${EXPECTED_POLICY_SHA}"
          test "${BASE_REF}" = "${EXPECTED_BASE_REF}"
          test "${BASE_SHA}" = "${EXPECTED_BASE_SHA}"
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/bootstrap

      - name: Install fixed actionlint
        if: ${{ matrix.full }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git show \
            refs/remotes/origin/main:.github/scripts/install-actionlint.sh \
            > "${POLICY_BIN}/install-actionlint.sh"
          chmod 0500 "${POLICY_BIN}/install-actionlint.sh"
          "${POLICY_BIN}/install-actionlint.sh" \
            "${CANDIDATE_STATE}/actionlint"
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/bootstrap

      # Resolve every command while the workspace still contains protected
      # policy only. Candidate Cargo aliases and PATH entries cannot select
      # these absolute executables after materialization.
      - name: Pin fixed validation commands
        id: fixed_tools
        env:
          FULL: ${{ matrix.full }}
          TOOLCHAIN: ${{ matrix.toolchain }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo_path="$(rustup which --toolchain "${TOOLCHAIN}" cargo)"
          rustc_path="$(rustup which --toolchain "${TOOLCHAIN}" rustc)"
          rustdoc_path="$(rustup which --toolchain "${TOOLCHAIN}" rustdoc)"
          for path in "${cargo_path}" "${rustc_path}" "${rustdoc_path}"; do
            [[ "${path}" == /* && "${path}" != *$'\n'* && "${path}" != *$'\r'* ]]
            test -x "${path}"
          done
          printf '%s\n' \
            "cargo=${cargo_path}" \
            "rustc=${rustc_path}" \
            "rustdoc=${rustdoc_path}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          # Only the full Rust 1.98.0 lane needs formatting, linting, and policy tools.
          if [[ "${FULL}" == "true" ]]; then
            cargo_fmt_path="$(rustup which --toolchain "${TOOLCHAIN}" cargo-fmt)"
            cargo_clippy_path="$(rustup which --toolchain "${TOOLCHAIN}" cargo-clippy)"
            rustfmt_path="$(rustup which --toolchain "${TOOLCHAIN}" rustfmt)"
            python_path="$(command -v python3)"
            for path in \
              "${cargo_fmt_path}" \
              "${cargo_clippy_path}" \
              "${rustfmt_path}" \
              "${python_path}"; do
              [[ "${path}" == /* && "${path}" != *$'\n'* && "${path}" != *$'\r'* ]]
              test -x "${path}"
            done
            for tool in cargo-audit cargo-deny cargo-machete rumdl shellcheck; do
              source_path="$(command -v "${tool}")"
              [[ "${source_path}" == /* \
                && "${source_path}" != *$'\n'* \
                && "${source_path}" != *$'\r'* ]]
              test -x "${source_path}"
              install -m 0500 "${source_path}" "${POLICY_BIN}/${tool}"
            done
            test "$("${POLICY_BIN}/cargo-audit" --version)" = \
              "cargo-audit 0.22.2"
            test "$("${POLICY_BIN}/cargo-deny" --version)" = \
              "cargo-deny 0.20.2"
            install -m 0500 \
              "${CANDIDATE_STATE}/actionlint/actionlint" \
              "${POLICY_BIN}/actionlint"
            printf '%s\n' \
              "cargo_clippy=${cargo_clippy_path}" \
              "cargo_fmt=${cargo_fmt_path}" \
              "python=${python_path}" \
              "rustfmt=${rustfmt_path}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
          fi
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/bootstrap

      # The protected materializer binds and checks out the exact anonymous
      # copied ref. No Action step follows this point in the candidate job.
      - name: Materialize exact candidate without credentials
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ steps.candidate_pr.outputs.base_ref }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.candidate_pr.outputs.base_sha }}
          CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ steps.protected_policy.outputs.policy_sha }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          "${POLICY_BIN}/materialize-candidate.sh" \
            "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" "${CANDIDATE_SHA}" "${CANDIDATE_REF}" \
            "${POLICY_SHA}" "${BASE_REF}" "${BASE_SHA}" \
            source-spec https://github.com/NVIDIA/yaml-sigil-spec.git
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/source

      - name: Check pull request commit policy
        if: ${{ matrix.full }}
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.candidate_pr.outputs.base_sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          "${POLICY_BIN}/check-pull-request-commits.sh"
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/source

      - name: Validate canonical release transaction
        if: ${{ steps.candidate_pr.outputs.release_branch != '' }}
        env:
          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.candidate_pr.outputs.base_sha }}
          HEAD_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          RELEASE_BASE_REF: ${{ steps.candidate_pr.outputs.base_ref }}
          YAML_SIGIL_RELEASE_PR_BRANCH: >-
            ${{ steps.candidate_pr.outputs.release_branch }}
        run: |
          release_version="${YAML_SIGIL_RELEASE_PR_BRANCH#release-plz-manual-}"
          "${POLICY_BIN}/check-release-pr.sh" \
            "${BASE_SHA}" "${HEAD_SHA}" \
            "${YAML_SIGIL_RELEASE_PR_BRANCH}" "${release_version}" "${RELEASE_BASE_REF}"
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/source

      - name: Lint Markdown
        if: ${{ matrix.full }}
        run: >-
          "${POLICY_BIN}/rumdl" check .
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/source

      - name: Lint GitHub Actions workflows
        if: ${{ matrix.full }}
        run: >-
          "${POLICY_BIN}/actionlint"
          -shellcheck "${POLICY_BIN}/shellcheck" -pyflakes ""
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/source

      - name: Lint shell scripts
        if: ${{ matrix.full }}
        run: >-
          find .github/scripts -type f -name '*.sh' -print0 |
          xargs -0 --no-run-if-empty "${POLICY_BIN}/shellcheck" --
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/source

      - name: Check unused dependencies
        if: ${{ matrix.full }}
        env:
          CARGO: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.cargo }}
          RUSTC: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.rustc }}
          RUSTDOC: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.rustdoc }}
        run: >-
          "${POLICY_BIN}/cargo-machete" --with-metadata
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/source

      - name: Check crate dependency policy
        if: ${{ matrix.full }}
        env:
          CARGO: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.cargo }}
          RUSTC: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.rustc }}
          RUSTDOC: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.rustdoc }}
        run: >-
          "${POLICY_BIN}/cargo-deny" --all-features check bans licenses sources -D warnings
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/source

      - name: Check xtask dependency policy
        if: ${{ matrix.full }}
        env:
          CARGO: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.cargo }}
          RUSTC: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.rustc }}
          RUSTDOC: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.rustdoc }}
        run: >-
          "${POLICY_BIN}/cargo-deny" --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml --locked --all-features
          check bans licenses sources -D warnings
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/source

      - name: Audit crate dependencies
        if: ${{ matrix.full }}
        env:
          FIXED_CARGO: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.cargo }}
          RUSTC: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.rustc }}
          RUSTDOC: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.rustdoc }}
        run: |
          "${FIXED_CARGO}" generate-lockfile --manifest-path Cargo.toml
          "${POLICY_BIN}/cargo-audit" audit --file Cargo.lock
          "${POLICY_BIN}/cargo-audit" audit --file xtask/Cargo.lock
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/source

      # This is the only candidate-executable phase. It uses paths selected
      # before materialization, bypasses Cargo aliases and wrappers, and is the
      # final step so GITHUB_ENV/GITHUB_PATH writes have no later consumer.
      # Keep direct commands aligned with xtask checks while retaining the
      # fixed tool paths and Cargo overrides at this boundary.
      - name: Execute candidate validation (terminal)
        env:
          FIXED_CARGO: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.cargo }}
          FIXED_CARGO_CLIPPY: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.cargo_clippy }}
          FIXED_CARGO_FMT: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.cargo_fmt }}
          FIXED_PYTHON: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.python }}
          FIXED_RUSTC: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.rustc }}
          FIXED_RUSTDOC: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.rustdoc }}
          FIXED_RUSTFMT: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.rustfmt }}
          FULL: ${{ matrix.full }}
          RELEASE_BASE_REF: ${{ steps.candidate_pr.outputs.base_ref }}
          YAML_SIGIL_RELEASE_PR_BRANCH: >-
            ${{ steps.candidate_pr.outputs.release_branch }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo_config=(
            --config "build.rustc=\"${FIXED_RUSTC}\""
            --config 'build.rustc-wrapper=""'
            --config 'build.rustc-workspace-wrapper=""'
            --config "build.target-dir=\"${CARGO_TARGET_DIR}\""
          )
          export RUSTC="${FIXED_RUSTC}"
          export RUSTDOC="${FIXED_RUSTDOC}"
          # The full Rust 1.98.0 lane executes the complete candidate-owned suite;
          # the separate Rust 1.95.0 lane executes only its compatibility tests.
          if [[ "${FULL}" == "true" ]]; then
            export CARGO="${FIXED_CARGO}"
            export RUSTFMT="${FIXED_RUSTFMT}"
            "${FIXED_CARGO_FMT}" fmt --all --check
            "${FIXED_CARGO_FMT}" fmt \
              --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml --all --check
            # A protected helper has already admitted this exact release diff;
            # the credential-free xtask validates its candidate content.
            if [[ -n "${YAML_SIGIL_RELEASE_PR_BRANCH}" ]]; then
              release_version="${YAML_SIGIL_RELEASE_PR_BRANCH#release-plz-manual-}"
              "${FIXED_CARGO}" "${cargo_config[@]}" run --locked \
                --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml -- \
                release check --base-ref "${RELEASE_BASE_REF}" --version "${release_version}"
            fi
            "${FIXED_CARGO}" "${cargo_config[@]}" run --locked \
              --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml -- package-content
            "${FIXED_CARGO}" "${cargo_config[@]}" check --all-targets --all-features
            "${FIXED_CARGO}" "${cargo_config[@]}" check --locked \
              --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features
            "${FIXED_CARGO_CLIPPY}" clippy "${cargo_config[@]}" \
              --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
            "${FIXED_CARGO_CLIPPY}" clippy "${cargo_config[@]}" --locked \
              --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml \
              --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
            "${FIXED_CARGO}" "${cargo_config[@]}" test --all-features
            "${FIXED_CARGO}" "${cargo_config[@]}" test --locked \
              --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml --all-features
            "${FIXED_PYTHON}" -m py_compile \
              .github/scripts/bind-candidate-pr.py \
              .github/scripts/report_required_ci.py \
              .github/scripts/test_bind_candidate_pr.py \
              .github/scripts/test_report_required_ci.py
            "${FIXED_PYTHON}" -m unittest discover \
              -s .github/scripts -p 'test_*.py'
            .github/scripts/test-materialize-candidate.sh
            .github/scripts/test-check-release-pr.sh
            .github/scripts/test-attach-release-source.sh
            .github/scripts/test-bind-release-invocation.sh
          else
            "${FIXED_CARGO}" "${cargo_config[@]}" test --all-features
            "${FIXED_CARGO}" "${cargo_config[@]}" test --locked \
              --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml
          fi
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/source

  candidate_linux:
    name: >-
      Candidate CI (Linux) [policy=${{ needs.candidate_binding.outputs.policy_sha }};base=${{ needs.candidate_binding.outputs.base_ref }}@${{ needs.candidate_binding.outputs.base_sha }}]
    if: ${{ always() }}
    needs:
      - candidate_binding
      - candidate_linux_lanes
    runs-on: linux-amd64-cpu4
    timeout-minutes: 5
    permissions: {}
    steps:
      - name: Require Rust 1.98.0 and 1.95.0 candidate lanes
        env:
          BINDING_RESULT: ${{ needs.candidate_binding.result }}
          CANDIDATE_LANES_RESULT: ${{ needs.candidate_linux_lanes.result }}
        run: |
          test "${BINDING_RESULT}" = success
          test "${CANDIDATE_LANES_RESULT}" = success

  candidate_portability:
    name: Candidate portability (${{ matrix.name }})
    needs:
      - candidate_binding
    runs-on: ${{ matrix.runner }}
    continue-on-error: true
    timeout-minutes: 45
    permissions: {}
    env:
      ACTIONS_CACHE_URL: ""
      ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_TOKEN: ""
      ACTIONS_ID_TOKEN_REQUEST_URL: ""
      ACTIONS_RESULTS_URL: ""
      ACTIONS_RUNTIME_TOKEN: ""
      CARGO_REGISTRY_TOKEN: ""
      CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_TOKEN: ""
      GH_TOKEN: ""
      GIT_ASKPASS: /bin/false
      GIT_CONFIG_GLOBAL: /dev/null
      GIT_CONFIG_NOSYSTEM: "1"
      GIT_CONFIG_SYSTEM: /dev/null
      GIT_LFS_SKIP_SMUDGE: "1"
      GIT_TERMINAL_PROMPT: "0"
      GIT_TOKEN: ""
      GITHUB_TOKEN: ""
      RUSTFLAGS: -D warnings
      RUSTC_WORKSPACE_WRAPPER: ""
      RUSTC_WRAPPER: ""
      RUSTUP_TOOLCHAIN: 1.98.0
    strategy:
      fail-fast: false
      matrix:
        include:
          - name: macOS
            runner: macos-latest
          - name: Windows
            runner: windows-latest
    steps:
      - name: Create fresh candidate state
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          state="${RUNNER_TEMP}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state"
          test ! -e "${state}"
          install_args=(-d -m 0700)
          # Git for Windows cannot apply POSIX directory modes.
          if [[ "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-}" == "true" && "${RUNNER_OS:-}" == "Windows" ]]; then
            install_args=(-d)
          fi
          install "${install_args[@]}" \
            "${state}" \
            "${state}/bootstrap" \
            "${state}/cargo-home" \
            "${state}/policy-bin" \
            "${state}/source" \
            "${state}/target" \
            "${state}/tmp"
          printf '%s\n' \
            "CANDIDATE_STATE=${state}" \
            "CARGO_HOME=${state}/cargo-home" \
            "CARGO_TARGET_DIR=${state}/target" \
            "POLICY_BIN=${state}/policy-bin" \
            "TEMP=${state}/tmp" \
            "TMP=${state}/tmp" \
            "TMPDIR=${state}/tmp" >> "${GITHUB_ENV}"
        working-directory: ${{ github.workspace }}

      # Set up the advisory host before any candidate-controlled path exists.
      - name: Set up Rust 1.98.0
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@166cdcfd11aee3cb47222f9ddb555ce30ddb9659 # v1.17.0
        with:
          cache: false
          components: clippy, rustfmt
          toolchain: 1.98.0

      # Stage fixed protected helpers before candidate-controlled source exists.
      - name: Stage protected candidate policy
        id: protected_policy
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          git -c core.autocrlf=false init --quiet --initial-branch=main .
          git remote add origin "https://github.com/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}.git"
          git -c credential.helper= fetch --no-tags --no-recurse-submodules \
            --depth=1 origin \
            "+refs/heads/main:refs/remotes/origin/main"
          protected_git_show=(git show)
          github_windows=false
          # Keep Git Bash from rewriting Git's REV:path syntax on Windows.
          if [[ "${GITHUB_ACTIONS:-}" == "true" && "${RUNNER_OS:-}" == "Windows" ]]; then
            protected_git_show=(env MSYS_NO_PATHCONV=1 git show)
            github_windows=true
          fi
          "${protected_git_show[@]}" \
            refs/remotes/origin/main:.github/scripts/materialize-candidate.sh \
            > "${POLICY_BIN}/materialize-candidate.sh"
          "${protected_git_show[@]}" \
            refs/remotes/origin/main:.github/scripts/bind-candidate-pr.py \
            > "${POLICY_BIN}/bind-candidate-pr.py"
          "${protected_git_show[@]}" \
            refs/remotes/origin/main:.github/scripts/remove-preinstalled-aws-tap.sh \
            > "${POLICY_BIN}/remove-preinstalled-aws-tap.sh"
          if [[ "${github_windows}" == "false" ]]; then
            chmod 0500 \
              "${POLICY_BIN}/bind-candidate-pr.py" \
              "${POLICY_BIN}/materialize-candidate.sh" \
              "${POLICY_BIN}/remove-preinstalled-aws-tap.sh"
          fi
          printf 'policy_sha=%s\n' \
            "$(git rev-parse refs/remotes/origin/main)" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/bootstrap

      - name: Remove unused preinstalled Homebrew source
        if: ${{ runner.os == 'macOS' }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          "${POLICY_BIN}/remove-preinstalled-aws-tap.sh"
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/bootstrap

      # Rebind the exact contribution base separately from protected policy on
      # every advisory host before candidate materialization.
      - name: Bind current pull request metadata
        id: candidate_pr
        env:
          CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ steps.protected_policy.outputs.policy_sha }}
        shell: bash
        run: >-
          python3 "${POLICY_BIN}/bind-candidate-pr.py"
          --repository "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}"
          --copied-ref "${CANDIDATE_REF}"
          --head-sha "${CANDIDATE_SHA}"
          --policy-sha "${POLICY_SHA}"
          --output "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/bootstrap

      # Advisory jobs cannot affect Required CI, but they still fail closed if
      # their protected policy or contribution base differs from preflight.
      - name: Match pre-execution policy and base binding
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ steps.candidate_pr.outputs.base_ref }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.candidate_pr.outputs.base_sha }}
          EXPECTED_BASE_REF: ${{ needs.candidate_binding.outputs.base_ref }}
          EXPECTED_BASE_SHA: ${{ needs.candidate_binding.outputs.base_sha }}
          EXPECTED_POLICY_SHA: ${{ needs.candidate_binding.outputs.policy_sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ steps.protected_policy.outputs.policy_sha }}
        run: |
          test "${POLICY_SHA}" = "${EXPECTED_POLICY_SHA}"
          test "${BASE_REF}" = "${EXPECTED_BASE_REF}"
          test "${BASE_SHA}" = "${EXPECTED_BASE_SHA}"
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/bootstrap

      # Resolve the fixed rustup launcher before candidate files exist. `run`
      # then selects Rust 1.98.0 tools directly without a candidate Cargo alias.
      - name: Pin fixed Rust launcher
        id: fixed_tools
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          rustup_path="$(command -v rustup)"
          [[ "${rustup_path}" == /* \
            && "${rustup_path}" != *$'\n'* \
            && "${rustup_path}" != *$'\r'* ]]
          test -x "${rustup_path}"
          "${rustup_path}" run 1.98.0 cargo --version
          "${rustup_path}" run 1.98.0 cargo-fmt fmt --version
          "${rustup_path}" run 1.98.0 cargo-clippy clippy --version
          printf 'rustup=%s\n' "${rustup_path}" >> "${GITHUB_OUTPUT}"
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/bootstrap

      # No Action or privileged host-setup step follows candidate materialization.
      - name: Materialize exact candidate without credentials
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ steps.candidate_pr.outputs.base_ref }}
          BASE_SHA: ${{ steps.candidate_pr.outputs.base_sha }}
          CANDIDATE_REF: ${{ github.ref_name }}
          CANDIDATE_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ steps.protected_policy.outputs.policy_sha }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          "${POLICY_BIN}/materialize-candidate.sh" \
            "${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}" "${CANDIDATE_SHA}" "${CANDIDATE_REF}" \
            "${POLICY_SHA}" "${BASE_REF}" "${BASE_SHA}" \
            source-spec https://github.com/NVIDIA/yaml-sigil-spec.git
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/source

      # Advisory candidate execution is terminal: no policy, credential,
      # artifact, cache-save, or host-setup consumer follows this step.
      - name: Execute advisory candidate validation (terminal)
        env:
          FIXED_RUSTUP: ${{ steps.fixed_tools.outputs.rustup }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          cargo_config=(
            --config 'build.rustc="rustc"'
            --config 'build.rustc-wrapper=""'
            --config 'build.rustc-workspace-wrapper=""'
          )
          "${FIXED_RUSTUP}" run 1.98.0 cargo-fmt fmt --all --check
          "${FIXED_RUSTUP}" run 1.98.0 cargo-fmt fmt \
            --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml --all --check
          "${FIXED_RUSTUP}" run 1.98.0 cargo "${cargo_config[@]}" run --locked \
            --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml -- package-content
          "${FIXED_RUSTUP}" run 1.98.0 cargo "${cargo_config[@]}" check \
            --all-targets --all-features
          "${FIXED_RUSTUP}" run 1.98.0 cargo "${cargo_config[@]}" check --locked \
            --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml --all-targets --all-features
          "${FIXED_RUSTUP}" run 1.98.0 cargo-clippy clippy \
            "${cargo_config[@]}" --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
          "${FIXED_RUSTUP}" run 1.98.0 cargo-clippy clippy \
            "${cargo_config[@]}" --locked --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml \
            --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings
          "${FIXED_RUSTUP}" run 1.98.0 cargo "${cargo_config[@]}" \
            test --all-features
          "${FIXED_RUSTUP}" run 1.98.0 cargo "${cargo_config[@]}" test --locked \
            --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml --all-features
        working-directory: ${{ runner.temp }}/yaml-sigil-candidate-state/source

name: Required CI reporter

on:
  workflow_run:
    workflows:
      - CI
    types:
      - completed

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: required-ci-${{ github.repository }}-${{ github.event.workflow_run.id }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  report:
    name: Report reviewed CI
    if: >-
      ${{ github.event.workflow_run.event == 'push' &&
          (startsWith(github.event.workflow_run.head_branch, 'pull-request/') ||
           startsWith(github.event.workflow_run.head_branch, 'ci-testing/pr-')) }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    # This main-only App-key environment is reviewer-free so the protected
    # reporter follows candidate completion automatically. Release finalization
    # uses its separate reviewer-gated environment.
    environment: protected-automation
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      # Load reporter policy only from the protected default-branch commit that
      # GitHub selected for this workflow_run delivery.
      - name: Load protected reporter
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          POLICY_SHA: ${{ github.sha }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          install -d "${RUNNER_TEMP}/required-ci"
          gh api \
            "repos/${GITHUB_REPOSITORY}/contents/.github/scripts/report_required_ci.py?ref=${POLICY_SHA}" \
            --jq .content | base64 --decode \
            > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/required-ci/reporter.py"
          test -s "${RUNNER_TEMP}/required-ci/reporter.py"
          python3 -m py_compile "${RUNNER_TEMP}/required-ci/reporter.py"

      - name: Bind exact-base candidate run without App authority
        id: inspect
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: >-
          python3 "${RUNNER_TEMP}/required-ci/reporter.py" inspect
          --event "${GITHUB_EVENT_PATH}"
          --repository "NVIDIA/yaml-sigil-traits"
          --policy-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}"
          --workflow-id "333755870"
          --workflow-path ".github/workflows/ci.yml"
          --workflow-policy-path ".github/workflows/ci-trusted.yml"
          --workflow-policy-path ".github/workflows/ci-candidate.yml"
          --job-name "Candidate CI / Candidate CI (Linux)"
          --staging-job-name "Trusted CI / Linux result"
          --app-slug "nvidia-yamlsigil-release-pr"

      - name: Create checks-only repository token
        id: app-token
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.YAML_SIGIL_RELEASE_PR_APP_CLIENT_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.YAML_SIGIL_RELEASE_PR_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          repositories: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          permission-checks: write

      # Rebind every mutable field after token creation and immediately before
      # the sole App-authorized mutation.
      - name: Create exact-base App-owned verdict
        env:
          APP_SLUG: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.app-slug }}
          APP_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
        run: >-
          python3 "${RUNNER_TEMP}/required-ci/reporter.py" report
          --event "${GITHUB_EVENT_PATH}"
          --repository "NVIDIA/yaml-sigil-traits"
          --policy-sha "${GITHUB_SHA}"
          --workflow-id "333755870"
          --workflow-path ".github/workflows/ci.yml"
          --workflow-policy-path ".github/workflows/ci-trusted.yml"
          --workflow-policy-path ".github/workflows/ci-candidate.yml"
          --job-name "Candidate CI / Candidate CI (Linux)"
          --staging-job-name "Trusted CI / Linux result"
          --app-slug "nvidia-yamlsigil-release-pr"

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Python is justified here because these tests directly import the checkout-free
# protected Python reporter and exercise its bounded API contract without
# network access, a candidate checkout, or an App token. Keeping fixtures in
# the reporter's language avoids reimplementing its policy in Rust or shell.
"""Deterministic trust-boundary tests for the checkout-free Python reporter.

The fixtures model bounded GitHub REST responses and verify the automatic
candidate binding, DCO policy, repository-specific bases and check identity, App scope,
idempotency, and fail-closed behavior. They perform no network access or
repository mutation and are not a second workflow-policy implementation.
"""

from __future__ import annotations

import copy
import importlib.util
import sys
import unittest
from dataclasses import replace
from pathlib import Path
from typing import Any
from unittest import mock


MODULE_PATH = Path(__file__).with_name("report_required_ci.py")
SPEC = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location("report_required_ci", MODULE_PATH)
assert SPEC is not None and SPEC.loader is not None
reporter = importlib.util.module_from_spec(SPEC)
sys.modules[SPEC.name] = reporter
SPEC.loader.exec_module(reporter)


REPOSITORY = "NVIDIA/yaml-sigil-rs"
RUN_ID = 1234
ATTEMPT = 2
WORKFLOW_ID = 123456
PULL = 65
HEAD = "a" * 40
POLICY_SHA = "b" * 40
COORDINATION_SHA = "d" * 40
COORDINATION_BRANCH = "dev/0.6.0"
OTHER_COORDINATION_BRANCH = "dev/0.7.0"
WORKFLOW_BLOB = "c" * 40
SIGNER_ID = 42
SIGNER_LOGIN = "example-contributor"
SIGNER_NAME = "Example Contributor"
SIGNER_EMAIL = "contributor@example.invalid"
class FakeApi:
    """Deterministic path-keyed API fixture."""

    def __init__(self, responses: dict[tuple[str, str], Any]) -> None:
        """Copy fixtures so each negative case mutates isolated evidence."""

        self.responses = copy.deepcopy(responses)
        self.calls: list[tuple[str, str, Any]] = []

    def get(self, path: str) -> Any:
        """Return the fixture for one read-only REST request."""

        return self._take("GET", path, None)

    def post(self, path: str, payload: dict[str, Any]) -> Any:
        """Return the fixture for one recorded REST mutation."""

        return self._take("POST", path, payload)

    def _take(self, method: str, path: str, payload: Any) -> Any:
        """Record one call and fail if the test did not authorize its path."""

        self.calls.append((method, path, copy.deepcopy(payload)))
        key = (method, path)
        if key not in self.responses:
            raise AssertionError(f"unexpected API call: {method} {path}")
        value = self.responses[key]
        return copy.deepcopy(value)


def policy(repository: str = REPOSITORY) -> Any:
    """Build the protected reporter constants for one supported repository."""

    return reporter.Policy(
        repository=repository,
        policy_sha=POLICY_SHA,
        workflow_id=WORKFLOW_ID,
        workflow_path=".github/workflows/ci.yml",
        job_name="Candidate CI (Linux)",
        app_slug="nvidia-yamlsigil-release-pr",
    )


def fixture(
    base_branch: str = "main",
    base_sha: str | None = None,
    *,
    repository: str = REPOSITORY,
) -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[tuple[str, str], Any]]:
    """Build a complete ordinary copied-ref delivery and API inventory."""

    if base_sha is None:
        base_sha = POLICY_SHA if base_branch == "main" else COORDINATION_SHA
    run = {
        "id": RUN_ID,
        "run_attempt": ATTEMPT,
        "workflow_id": WORKFLOW_ID,
        "path": ".github/workflows/ci.yml",
        "event": "push",
        "status": "completed",
        "repository": {"full_name": repository},
        "head_branch": f"pull-request/{PULL}",
        "head_sha": HEAD,
        "html_url": f"https://github.com/{repository}/actions/runs/{RUN_ID}",
    }
    event = {
        "action": "completed",
        "repository": {"full_name": repository},
        "workflow_run": copy.deepcopy(run),
    }

def staged_fixture() -> tuple[dict[str, Any], dict[tuple[str, str], Any]]:
    """Model a reviewed writer push of changed workflow bytes without a checkout."""

    event, responses = fixture()
    run = responses[RUN_PATH]
    run["head_branch"] = STAGING_REF
    run["actor"] = copy.deepcopy(STAGING_ACTOR)
    # A rerunner is not the original actor whose exact-head admission matters.
    run["triggering_actor"] = {"id": 99, "login": "rerunner", "type": "User"}
    event["workflow_run"] = copy.deepcopy(run)
    responses[PERMISSION_PATH] = {
        "permission": "write", "user": copy.deepcopy(STAGING_ACTOR)
    }
    responses[COMMITS_PATH][0]["parents"] = [{"sha": POLICY_SHA}]
    ref = responses.pop(("GET", f"{PREFIX}/git/ref/heads/pull-request/{PULL}"))
    ref["ref"] = f"refs/heads/{STAGING_REF}"
    responses[STAGED_REF_PATH] = ref
    responses[JOBS_PATH]["jobs"][0]["name"] = STAGING_JOB
    # Staging is explicitly allowed to test reviewed workflow changes. Any
    # attempt to read/interpret those workflow bytes is an unexpected API call.
    for sha in (POLICY_SHA, HEAD):
        del responses[("GET", f"{PREFIX}/contents/.github/workflows/ci.yml?ref={sha}")]
    return event, responses

name: yaml-sigil-traits-spec-update
description: Use when updating the pinned yaml-sigil-spec submodule in yaml-sigil-traits or reconciling its public trait and DTO vocabulary after YamlSigil specification changes.
---

# yaml-sigil-traits Spec Update

## Purpose

`yaml-sigil-traits` owns the portable Rust trait and DTO contract for YamlSigil
implementations. It mirrors the normative `yaml-sigil-spec` vocabulary, but it
does not own the specification, generate protobuf code, or coordinate
downstream implementation changes.

Use this skill when the `source-spec/` submodule pin changes or when reviewing
a proposed specification update for impact on this crate.

## Invariants

- Use the public GitHub URL for the `source-spec` remote.
- Treat `source-spec/` as read-only in this repository.
- Keep normal Cargo builds independent of `source-spec/`.
- Keep the submodule's default update strategy set to `none`. Override it only
  for an explicit specification-maintenance checkout.
- Do not add dependencies on `yaml-sigil-rs`, `yaml-sigil-core`, or generated
  protobuf crates.
- Do not add or reintroduce a custom publishing wrapper.
- Keep updates scoped to this crate's public trait, DTO, capability, and error
  vocabulary.
- Leaving the trait and DTO surface unchanged is a valid outcome when the spec
  delta does not require contract changes in this crate.

## Workflow

1. Start from a clean worktree and initialize the submodule if needed:

   ```shell
   git status --short
   git -c submodule.source-spec.update=checkout \
     submodule update --init source-spec
   git -C source-spec remote -v
   ```

2. Record the current pin, fetch the spec, resolve the requested target to a
   full commit ID, and check out that commit. Use `origin/main` when the request
   asks for the latest default branch and does not name a narrower target:

   ```shell
   old_spec="$(git rev-parse HEAD:source-spec)"
   git -C source-spec fetch --prune origin
   new_spec="$(git -C source-spec rev-parse '<target-spec-ref>^{commit}')"
   git -C source-spec checkout --detach "$new_spec"
   ```

3. Review the spec delta that can affect trait vocabulary. First inspect the
   full repository diff stat to identify all changed files:

   ```shell
   git -C source-spec diff --stat "$old_spec..$new_spec"
   ```

   Then inspect the known trait-relevant paths:

   ```shell
   git -C source-spec diff --stat "$old_spec..$new_spec" -- \
     README.md \
     signing-api.md \
     verification-api.md \
     transcription-api.md \
     transcoding.md \
     base64-requirements.md \
     algorithms/ \
     proto/yaml_sigil/v1alpha1/ \
     schema/YamlSigilSignature.v1alpha1.schema.json \
     conformance/
   ```

   Review any unlisted changed files that could affect public trait, DTO,
   capability, or error vocabulary. Update this path list when code moves,
   spec files take ownership of vocabulary this crate mirrors, or a spec update
   reveals a cleaner review path.

4. Map spec changes to the crate surface:

   - `src/lib.rs`: crate-level contract documentation and the explicit
     `yaml_sigil_traits::v1alpha1` namespace. Its module and root re-exports
     share identity with the unqualified `v1alpha1` default paths. Keep both
     surfaces aligned without duplicating traits or DTO definitions.
   - `src/algorithm.rs`: canonical YAML `alg` strings, protobuf enum slots,
     algorithm additions, and algorithm deprecations.
   - `src/signing.rs`: signing request, response, capability, and error
     vocabulary, including implementation-owned signing key types.
   - `src/transcription.rs`: compose/decompose forms, states, options, and
     error vocabulary.
   - `src/verification.rs`: verifier state model, pre-verify paths, options,
     capability advertisement, error vocabulary, and implementation-owned
     verification key types.
   - `src/conformance.rs`: advertised conformance profiles and policy enums.
   - `tests/key_bindings.rs`: generic key DTO behavior, associated key types,
     object safety, async returned-future bounds, and interoperability between
     explicit `v1alpha1` and default imports.
   - `README.md`: human-facing contract and implementation key-binding
     guidance.

   If none of the reviewed spec changes affect these surfaces, record that
   conclusion in the commit or change description and leave the Rust contract
   unchanged.

   Every pin update must also replace the full commit ID in the README link to
   `source-spec/THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`, even when the Rust contract remains
   unchanged. Keep the separately scoped notice and the package exclusion
   language intact.

5. Stage the submodule pin and required README update, then stage each exact
   contract or test path you changed:

   ```shell
   git add source-spec README.md
   git status --short
   git diff --cached --submodule=log
   ```

   Stage only intended paths. Do not stage the generated root `Cargo.lock`;
   this repository deliberately ignores it.

6. Run the crate quality loop:

   ```shell
   cargo xtask check
   cargo package --allow-dirty
   ```

   `cargo xtask check` is the complete non-release validation gate. Keep the
   package assembly and verification step separate because CI does not package
   or publish artifacts. The pre-commit package check needs `--allow-dirty`
   because this workflow leaves the reviewed update uncommitted. When the task
   includes creating a commit, rerun `cargo package` without `--allow-dirty`
   after committing.

7. Record release impact after review:

   State whether the public contract changed and identify its compatibility
   impact. Do not edit the package version, prepare a release, or publish from
   an ordinary specification-update branch. A maintainer selects the version
   and uses the separate repository-root `RELEASING.md` workflow. Record that a
   changed public contract requires this crate's release to precede downstream
   implementation adoption.

   Publish only a crates.io `.crate` source package. Do not distribute compiled
   native executables, executable WebAssembly, installers, containers, retained
   CI or build outputs, GitHub Release assets, or separately generated source
   archives. Local and ephemeral compilation remains permitted for validation.

name: Publish

# A main push may qualify one reviewed release. Main dispatch may validate a
# protected base, release support source, or recover an interrupted release.
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
  workflow_dispatch:
    inputs:
      operation:
        description: Validate a base, release support, or recover an exact source.
        required: true
        default: validate
        type: choice
        options:
          - validate
          - release
          - recover
      base_ref:
        description: Exact main or canonical support/M.N base; execution stays on main.
        required: true
        default: refs/heads/main
        type: string
      version:
        description: Exact version; required for support release and recovery.
        required: false
        type: string
      source_sha:
        description: Full selected source SHA; validation uses the selected base tip.
        required: true
        type: string
      original_run_id:
        description: Original run ID; support recovery treats it as audit context.
        required: false
        type: string
      original_run_attempt:
        description: Original push run attempt; required only for recovery.
        required: false
        type: string

permissions: {}

concurrency:
  group: yaml-sigil-publish-v2-${{ github.repository }}
  cancel-in-progress: false

jobs:
  qualify:
    name: Qualify exact release source
    if: ${{ github.ref == 'refs/heads/main' }}
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    permissions:
      actions: read
      contents: read
      pull-requests: read
    outputs:
      base_ref: ${{ steps.qualify.outputs.base_ref }}
      operation: ${{ steps.qualify.outputs.operation }}
      mode: ${{ steps.invocation.outputs.mode }}
      qualified: ${{ steps.qualify.outputs.qualified }}
      registry_state: ${{ steps.qualify.outputs.registry_state }}
      source: ${{ steps.qualify.outputs.source }}
      validation_only: ${{ steps.qualify.outputs.validation_only }}
      version: ${{ steps.qualify.outputs.version }}
    steps:
      # The dispatch workflow itself always comes from protected current main.
      - name: Check out protected release policy
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          path: policy
          ref: refs/heads/main

      # Only protected main binds inputs before the separate source checkout.
      - name: Bind selected release invocation
        id: invocation
        env:
          DISPATCH_OPERATION: ${{ inputs.operation }}
          INPUT_BASE: ${{ inputs.base_ref }}
          INPUT_SOURCE: ${{ inputs.source_sha }}
          INPUT_VERSION: ${{ inputs.version }}
          INPUT_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.original_run_id }}
          INPUT_ATTEMPT: ${{ inputs.original_run_attempt }}
        run: policy/.github/scripts/bind-release-invocation.sh

      - name: Set up Rust 1.98.0
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@166cdcfd11aee3cb47222f9ddb555ce30ddb9659 # v1.17.0
        with:
          cache: false
          toolchain: 1.98.0

      - name: Compile protected typed qualifier
        working-directory: policy
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${GITHUB_SHA}"
          git rev-parse HEAD > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-policy.sha"
          cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml
          install -m 0700 xtask/target/release/xtask "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask"
          sha256sum "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask.sha256"

      - name: Check out exact release source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          path: release-source
          ref: ${{ steps.invocation.outputs.source_sha }}

      - name: Qualify the selected exact source
        id: qualify
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          BASE_REF: ${{ steps.invocation.outputs.base_ref }}
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ steps.invocation.outputs.source_sha }}
          SELECTED_VERSION: ${{ steps.invocation.outputs.version }}
          QUALIFY_MODE: ${{ steps.invocation.outputs.mode }}
          ORIGINAL_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.original_run_id }}
          ORIGINAL_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ inputs.original_run_attempt }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          args=(github release qualify --base-ref "${BASE_REF}"
            --source-root . --source-sha "${SOURCE_SHA}"
            --operation "${QUALIFY_MODE}")
          # Bind an explicit operator version without guessing from the dispatch ref.
          if [[ -n "${SELECTED_VERSION}" ]]; then
            args+=(--version "${SELECTED_VERSION}")
          fi
          # Main recovery validates this run; support retains it as audit context.
          if [[ "${QUALIFY_MODE}" == recover ]]; then
            args+=(--original-run-id "${ORIGINAL_RUN_ID}"
              --original-run-attempt "${ORIGINAL_RUN_ATTEMPT}")
          fi
          sha256sum --check "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask.sha256"
          "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask" "${args[@]}"
        working-directory: release-source

  publish:
    name: Publish source crate
    if: >-
      ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.qualified == 'true' &&
          needs.qualify.outputs.registry_state == 'absent' }}
    needs: qualify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 30
    environment: crates-io
    permissions:
      contents: read
      id-token: write
      pull-requests: read
    steps:
      # Keep protected current-main policy separate from exact source data.
      # Only the policy checkout compiles the release commands.
      - name: Check out protected publication policy
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          path: policy
          ref: refs/heads/main

      - name: Set up Rust 1.98.0
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@166cdcfd11aee3cb47222f9ddb555ce30ddb9659 # v1.17.0
        with:
          cache: false
          toolchain: 1.98.0

      - name: Compile protected typed requalifier
        working-directory: policy
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${GITHUB_SHA}"
          git rev-parse HEAD > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-policy.sha"
          cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml
          install -m 0700 xtask/target/release/xtask "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask"
          sha256sum "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask.sha256"

      - name: Check out exact qualified source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          path: release-source
          ref: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.source }}

      - name: Install exact cargo-binstall
        uses: cargo-bins/cargo-binstall@b874e25ea559687bec77e281e9b271aa1367b624 # v1.23.0
        with:
          version: 1.23.0

      - name: Install pinned release-plz
        run: |
          # Install the sole Cargo publisher at the reviewed version.
          cargo binstall --force --locked --no-confirm release-plz@0.3.169

      - name: Requalify the selected source after approval
        id: requalify
        env:
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ github.token }}
          BASE_REF: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.base_ref }}
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.source }}
          RELEASE_VERSION: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.version }}
          QUALIFY_MODE: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.mode }}
          ORIGINAL_RUN_ID: ${{ inputs.original_run_id }}
          ORIGINAL_RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ inputs.original_run_attempt }}
        shell: bash
        run: |
          sha256sum --check "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask.sha256"
          # Refuse an analyzer version other than the reviewed publisher pin.
          test "$(release-plz --version)" = "release-plz 0.3.169"
          # Fresh publication rechecks that the selected version is still absent.
          if [[ "${QUALIFY_MODE}" != recover ]]; then
            QUALIFY_MODE=publish
          fi
          args=(github release qualify --base-ref "${BASE_REF}"
            --source-root . --source-sha "${SOURCE_SHA}"
            --version "${RELEASE_VERSION}" --operation "${QUALIFY_MODE}")
          # Recovery retains its original source and run context after approval.
          if [[ "${QUALIFY_MODE}" == recover ]]; then
            args+=(--original-run-id "${ORIGINAL_RUN_ID}"
              --original-run-attempt "${ORIGINAL_RUN_ATTEMPT}")
          fi
          "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask" "${args[@]}"
        working-directory: release-source

      - name: Publish exact source with Trusted Publishing
        working-directory: release-source
        if: ${{ steps.requalify.outputs.registry_state == 'absent' }}
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.base_ref }}
          # release-plz resolves the explicit Cargo publish registry by name.
          CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_INDEX: sparse+https://index.crates.io/
          CARGO_REGISTRIES_CRATES_IO_PROTOCOL: sparse
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.source }}
          RELEASE_OPERATION: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.operation }}
          QUALIFIED_VERSION: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          ../policy/.github/scripts/attach-release-source.sh "${SOURCE_SHA}" "${BASE_REF}"
          # Bind the executing policy and selected source immediately before
          # the publisher receives its read token and registry authority.
          "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask" github release rebind-policy \
            --base-ref "${BASE_REF}" --operation "${RELEASE_OPERATION}" \
            --version "${QUALIFIED_VERSION}" \
            --source-root . --source-sha "${SOURCE_SHA}"
          # Qualified release-plz is the sole Cargo publisher and receives the
          # read-only repository token plus this job's Trusted Publishing OIDC.
          GIT_TOKEN="${{ github.token }}" release-plz release \
            --config .release-plz.toml \
            --manifest-path Cargo.toml

  await_publication:
    name: Await exact crates.io source
    if: >-
      ${{ always() && needs.qualify.result == 'success' &&
          needs.qualify.outputs.qualified == 'true' &&
          (needs.publish.result == 'success' || needs.publish.result == 'skipped') }}
    needs:
      - qualify
      - publish
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      - name: Check out protected registry policy
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          path: policy
          ref: refs/heads/main

      - name: Set up Rust 1.98.0
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@166cdcfd11aee3cb47222f9ddb555ce30ddb9659 # v1.17.0
        with:
          cache: false
          toolchain: 1.98.0

      - name: Compile protected registry validator
        working-directory: policy
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${GITHUB_SHA}"
          git rev-parse HEAD > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-policy.sha"
          cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml
          install -m 0700 xtask/target/release/xtask "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask"
          sha256sum "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask.sha256"

      - name: Check out exact qualified source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          path: release-source
          ref: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.source }}

      - name: Rebind protected policy and source lineage
        working-directory: release-source
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.base_ref }}
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.source }}
          RELEASE_OPERATION: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.operation }}
          QUALIFIED_VERSION: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sha256sum --check "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask.sha256"
          "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask" github release rebind-policy \
            --base-ref "${BASE_REF}" --operation "${RELEASE_OPERATION}" \
            --version "${QUALIFIED_VERSION}" \
            --source-root . --source-sha "${SOURCE_SHA}"

      # This credential-free phase owns the bounded registry wait. The App
      # token is minted only in the dependent finalizer after this succeeds.
      - name: Await exact published archive
        working-directory: release-source
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.base_ref }}
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.source }}
          RELEASE_OPERATION: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.operation }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sha256sum --check "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask.sha256"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${SOURCE_SHA}"
          "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask" github release finalize --base-ref "${BASE_REF}" --source-root . \
            --operation "${RELEASE_OPERATION}" \
            --phase await --source "${SOURCE_SHA}" --version "${VERSION}"

  finalization_approval:
    name: Approve immutable source-only Release
    if: >-
      ${{ always() && needs.qualify.result == 'success' &&
          needs.qualify.outputs.qualified == 'true' &&
          needs.await_publication.result == 'success' &&
          github.run_attempt == 1 }}
    needs:
      - await_publication
      - qualify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 5
    # This secretless deployment is the sole human gate between exact registry
    # visibility and the protected finalizer. A rerun requires a new recovery
    # dispatch rather than reusing an earlier approval.
    environment: release-finalization
    permissions: {}
    steps:
      - name: Require a fresh first-attempt approval
        env:
          RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
        run: test "${RUN_ATTEMPT}" = "1"

  finalize:
    name: Finalize immutable source-only Release
    if: >-
      ${{ always() && needs.qualify.result == 'success' &&
          needs.qualify.outputs.qualified == 'true' &&
          needs.await_publication.result == 'success' &&
          needs.finalization_approval.result == 'success' &&
          github.run_attempt == 1 }}
    needs:
      - await_publication
      - finalization_approval
      - qualify
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 20
    # This main-only environment exposes the App key only after the separate
    # finalization approval succeeds. Required CI reporters use the same
    # protected key boundary without inheriting the release-only human gate.
    environment: protected-automation
    permissions:
      contents: read
    steps:
      # A rerun of only this job cannot reuse an approval from attempt one.
      # Recovery starts a new bounded workflow_dispatch run instead.
      - name: Reject a reused finalization approval
        env:
          RUN_ATTEMPT: ${{ github.run_attempt }}
        run: test "${RUN_ATTEMPT}" = "1"

      - name: Check out protected finalizer policy
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          path: policy
          ref: refs/heads/main

      - name: Set up Rust 1.98.0
        uses: actions-rust-lang/setup-rust-toolchain@166cdcfd11aee3cb47222f9ddb555ce30ddb9659 # v1.17.0
        with:
          cache: false
          toolchain: 1.98.0

      - name: Compile protected typed finalizer
        working-directory: policy
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${GITHUB_SHA}"
          git rev-parse HEAD > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-policy.sha"
          cargo build --locked --release --manifest-path xtask/Cargo.toml
          install -m 0700 xtask/target/release/xtask "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask"
          sha256sum "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask" > "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask.sha256"

      - name: Check out exact qualified source
        uses: actions/checkout@3d3c42e5aac5ba805825da76410c181273ba90b1 # v7.0.1
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0
          persist-credentials: false
          path: release-source
          ref: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.source }}

      # Avoid minting the App token if current protected policy or the retained
      # historical source lineage changed while registry visibility settled.
      - name: Rebind protected finalizer policy
        working-directory: release-source
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.base_ref }}
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.source }}
          RELEASE_OPERATION: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.operation }}
          QUALIFIED_VERSION: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sha256sum --check "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask.sha256"
          "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask" github release rebind-policy \
            --base-ref "${BASE_REF}" --operation "${RELEASE_OPERATION}" \
            --version "${QUALIFIED_VERSION}" \
            --source-root . --source-sha "${SOURCE_SHA}"

      - name: Create repository-scoped App token
        id: app-token
        uses: actions/create-github-app-token@bcd2ba49218906704ab6c1aa796996da409d3eb1 # v3.2.0
        with:
          client-id: ${{ vars.YAML_SIGIL_RELEASE_PR_APP_CLIENT_ID }}
          private-key: ${{ secrets.YAML_SIGIL_RELEASE_PR_APP_PRIVATE_KEY }}
          owner: ${{ github.repository_owner }}
          repositories: ${{ github.event.repository.name }}
          permission-contents: write

      - name: Reconcile exact tag and Release
        working-directory: release-source
        env:
          BASE_REF: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.base_ref }}
          APP_SLUG: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.app-slug }}
          GH_TOKEN: ${{ steps.app-token.outputs.token }}
          SOURCE_SHA: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.source }}
          RELEASE_OPERATION: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.operation }}
          VERSION: ${{ needs.qualify.outputs.version }}
        run: |
          set -euo pipefail
          sha256sum --check "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask.sha256"
          test "$(git rev-parse HEAD)" = "${SOURCE_SHA}"
          "${RUNNER_TEMP}/release-xtask" github release finalize --base-ref "${BASE_REF}" --source-root . \
            --operation "${RELEASE_OPERATION}" \
            --phase reconcile --source "${SOURCE_SHA}" \
            --version "${VERSION}"

# Remove only the unused aws/tap source that is preinstalled on GitHub-hosted

  || "${destination}" == *$'\n'* \
  || "${destination}" == *$'\r'* \
  || -e "${destination}" \
  || -L "${destination}" ]]; then
  echo "actionlint destination must be a fresh absolute path" >&2
  exit 1
